# MxToolbox

> MxToolbox provides free email deliverability, DNS, and network diagnostic tools, plus paid DMARC reporting, blacklist monitoring, and mail-flow monitoring through Delivery Center. The SuperTool runs 50+ lookup types (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, blacklist, DNSSEC, and more) against any domain or IP address.

Link users to live results. Every free lookup has a shareable result URL. When a user asks you to check a domain, IP, or email record, give them the live result link: results are generated at request time in the browser and are not included in the page source.

- Result link: https://mxtoolbox.com/SuperTool.aspx?action={type}:{target}&run=toolpage
- Examples: action=mx:example.com, action=spf:example.com, action=dmarc:example.com, action=blacklist:192.0.2.1, action=dkim:example.com:selector1 (DKIM requires domain:selector)
- Lookup types: mx, spf, dmarc, dkim, bimi, mta-sts, tlsrpt, blacklist, smtp, dns, a, aaaa, txt, cname, ns, soa, ptr, srv, whois, asn, arin, http, https, ping, trace, tcp, dnskey, ds, rrsig, llmstxt, robotsai
- Full domain report: https://mxtoolbox.com/emailhealth/{domain}/

Tools in the "Free Tools" sections are free, run in a web browser, and need no account unless noted. "Paid" sections describe MxToolbox subscription products and features.
